changelog:
Initial release of Content Narrative Arc Analyzer — analyze and optimize the story structure of long-form content.

- Detects emotional highs/lows and maps pacing/engagement throughout your content
- Identifies weak hooks, transitions, and conclusions with actionable rewrite suggestions
- Supports multi-part series for tension and cohesion checks
- Compatible with blog posts, video scripts, email sequences, and more
- Integrates with WordPress, Slack, Google Docs, and video platforms via content pasting
- Includes prompts, example outputs, and full configuration options for custom analysis
display_name: Analyze Content Narrative Arc with AI — Structure & Flow Detection
summary: Analyze emotional journey and story structure in long-form content. Maps pacing, engagement, and narrative tension. Use when the user needs to strengthen hooks, identify weak transitions, or optimize multi-part series storytelling.
